title: Poketrainer Bootcamp
describes: Pokémon League bootcamp. Encounters on routes; a correct answer catches the Pokémon.

chooseOne.how: Tap the Pokémon you want to throw a ball at.
chooseOne.nudge: Pick any one of them. You cannot get this wrong in a way that costs you anything.

chooseMany.how: Tap every Pokémon that belongs, then confirm your team.
chooseMany.nudge: Tap one to add it, tap it again to take it off.

FLU-MATRIX-01.how: One badge is missing from the case. Work out the pattern across the rows and pick the Pokémon that belongs in the gap.
walkthrough: Look along the top row and see what changes from left to right.
Check the next row down changes the same way.
Now find the one that finishes the last row.

QUANT-SERIES-01.how: The route markers count up by a rule. Pick the marker that comes next.
walkthrough: See how much each marker adds to the one before it.
Add the same amount once more.

QUANT-DOTS-01.how: Two patches of grass. Tap the side with more Pokémon in it.

FLU-DEDUCE-01.how: Every note in your Pokédex is true about the one you want. Only one of these fits all of them.
